patch_description:
Add a wrap-around CZ + CRZ gate pair connecting qubit 7 to qubit 0, implementing ring-topology long-range coupling. This single additional parameter (crz_wrap) tests whether ring-based entanglement improves the validation-test generalization gap without significantly increasing circuit depth or parameter count.

The prior programs achieved validation accuracy of 0.93-0.94 but test accuracy of 0.89-0.90. The current program improved test accuracy to 0.91 but validation dropped to 0.92, reducing combined score to 0.90. Adding ring-topology coupling may help bridge this gap by enabling information flow across the full qubit register, potentially improving both validation accuracy and generalization.

This is a low-risk, parameter-efficient modification that leverages the natural ring structure of an 8-qubit system.
